name: FinBen

evaluation.primary_metric: task-specific metrics (EntityF1 / F1 / Accuracy / EmAcc / ROUGE / BertScore / BARTScore / MCC / RMSE / CR / SR / DV / AV / MD)

results_over_time.note: Release baseline from the NeurIPS 2024 / OpenReview final FinBen paper. This record follows the final 42-dataset, 24-task scope. Table 3 provides the main benchmark results for 12 models across non-trading tasks, and Table 4 adds stock-trading averages for large-context models. The paper uses slightly different naming conventions across the two tables (for example, ChatGPT in Table 3 and GPT3.5-Turbo in Table 4), so model names are copied as shown in the paper instead of merged by assumption.
Leaderboard data from HuggingFace Space (TheFinAI/Open-FinLLM-Leaderboard) as of 2026-04-22. All 39 individual metric scores plus Average included.

notes: This JSON follows the final NeurIPS 2024 / OpenReview FinBen scope (42 datasets, 24 tasks, bilingual English and Spanish), not the earlier arXiv 36-dataset version. FinBen is a benchmark for financial language models, but the official description also highlights agent-based and RAG evaluation, so used_llm_or_agent is set to both. dataset is left null deliberately: the public Hugging Face collections under TheFinAI are shared umbrella collections and language-specific collections rather than one clean, benchmark-wide FinBen-only dataset page covering the full final bilingual scope.
